<attList>

<attList> contains documentation for all the attributes associated with this element, as a series of <attDef> elements.
Attributes Global attributes only
Example 
<attList>
   <attDef> <!-- ... --> </attDef>
   <attDef> <!-- ... --> </attDef>
</attList>
Module Declared in file teitsd2; Auxiliary DTD for Tag Set documentation
Data Description contains a series of <attDef> elements only
May contain attDef
May occur within
Declaration 
<!ELEMENT attList %om.RO; (attDef*)> 
<!ATTLIST attList  
      %a.global;>
See further 27.1 The TagDoc Documentation Element; 27.2 Element Classes
